title: Listen
description: You tell me what you do by hand and how much time it costs you. If it helps, I come and see it.

title: Agree
description: Scope, timeline and price in writing before a single line of code gets written.

title: Build
description: Progress you can use from the first week, not a single delivery at the very end.

title: Ship and test
description: We test it against your real operation, I train whoever will use it, and support stays in place.
